item.title: Indoor golf course in Downtown Syracuse celebrates opening with bursting golf balls and a bunch of confetti
item.description: Five Iron Golf, a family-friendly indoor golf course and bar, opened in Downtown Syracuse on February 16, with a ceremonial ribbon-cutting event featuring Syracuse University football coach Fran Brown and Mayor Sharon Owens.

item.title: State bill introduced to tackle high energy costs
item.description: State Senator Chris Ryan is pushing for a package of bills to protect ratepayers and hold utility providers accountable, including measures to increase transparency and limit expenditures, as families across Central New York struggle with high energy bills.
